why: An empty catch or a .catch that returns nothing hides the failure: the work silently didn't happen and nobody is told. Handle it, rethrow with context, or let the boundary catch it.
good:
try { await save(x); } catch (err: unknown) { throw new Error('save failed', { cause: err }); }
await send(m).catch((err: unknown) => log.warn({ err }, 'send failed'));
